note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Argentina, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in ARS of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts for a households' disposable income account from 2019 on, found none: INDEC Cuentas nacionales section (www.indec.gob.ar/Nivel3/Tema/3/9), read 2026-11-03: its subtopics are Agregados macroeconómicos, EMAE, Generación del ingreso, Cuadros de oferta, Sectores institucionales, PIB por jurisdicción, Cuentas satélite, Productividad y stock de capital; none is a household account. INDEC Sectores institucionales (www.indec.gob.ar/Nivel4/Tema/3/9/118), read 2026-11-03: accounts are published only for general government (2024 preliminary, 2022-2023 revised), financial corporations and the rest of the world; workbook ftp/cuadros/economia/cuentas_sectores_institucionales.xls holds Cuadros 1-4, all government (general, central, provincial, municipal). No households sector. INDEC Generación del ingreso (Nivel4/Tema/3/9/49) is the generation-of-income account (compensation, mixed income, operating surplus), which stops before disposable income; INDEC's distribución del ingreso series is survey-based (EPH), not national accounts. Web search in Spanish (INDEC sectores institucionales, hogares, ingreso disponible) found no household account. Each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included.
